Please revise the draft to address the following points:

1. Purchase price: The Buyer proposes USD 36,000,000, subject to satisfactory due diligence and final agreement on the transaction economics. The price should be subject to a customary closing statement and dollar-for-dollar adjustment for indebtedness, cash, transaction expenses, and any shortfall in working capital against an agreed target. Please also provide the supporting financial and working-capital information needed to evaluate the proposed price.
2. Closing: Replace the fixed 30-day deadline with closing on an agreed date after satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions, including completion of due diligence and receipt of required approvals. Include customary termination rights and an outside date.
3. Representations and warranties: Replace the knowledge-qualified, materiality-qualified financial statement statement with customary Seller representations and warranties, including that the financial statements fairly present the Company’s financial condition and results in all material respects. Add customary representations covering organization, authority, capitalization, subsidiaries, accounts, liabilities, taxes, material contracts, compliance with law, litigation, employees, assets, intellectual property, and brokers. Include disclosure schedules, bring-down conditions, and customary survival and indemnification provisions, with appropriate caps, baskets, and an escrow or other security for indemnification obligations.
4. Interim operations and conditions: Add customary covenants governing operation of the business between signing and closing, access to information, and cooperation, together with customary closing conditions and deliverables.
5. Confidentiality: Make confidentiality mutual, subject to customary exceptions for disclosures to affiliates, financing sources, and professional advisers, and disclosures required by law. Coordinate this provision with any existing confidentiality agreement.
6. Complete the agreement with customary provisions addressing governing law, notices, assignment, entire agreement, amendments, counterparts, and dispute resolution.

edits.text: 1. Purchase Price; Closing Adjustment. The purchase price for the Shares is USD 45,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), subject to adjustment at Closing, dollar-for-dollar, for Company indebtedness, Company cash, unpaid transaction expenses and any shortfall in working capital relative to a target to be agreed by the parties. The parties will agree the accounting principles, estimated closing statement and post-Closing true-up procedures, including access to supporting records and an independent accountant process for disputed items, in the definitive agreement. The Seller will make available financial and working-capital information reasonably available to it through the agreed diligence process, subject to the confidentiality agreement and applicable law.

2. Closing; Conditions. Closing will occur on a date agreed by the parties after satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing, including completion of Buyer’s due diligence to its satisfaction, receipt of required governmental and other approvals, accuracy of the applicable representations and warranties (subject to agreed materiality standards), and performance in all material respects of the parties’ covenants. The definitive agreement will include customary termination rights and an outside date, with extensions where appropriate, and customary closing deliverables. Between signing and Closing, the Seller will cause the Company to operate in the ordinary course, subject to agreed exceptions, and will provide reasonable access to personnel, properties, books and records, subject to applicable law and privilege. The parties will cooperate in seeking required approvals and effecting the transaction.

3. Representations; Indemnification. The definitive agreement will contain customary representations and warranties of the Seller and, as appropriate, the Company, including as to organization, authority, capitalization, subsidiaries, accounts and financial statements (which will fairly present the Company’s financial condition and results in all material respects), liabilities, taxes, material contracts, compliance with law, litigation, employees, assets, intellectual property and brokers, in each case subject to negotiated qualifications and disclosure schedules. Representations and warranties will be brought down at Closing and will survive for agreed periods. The agreement will provide customary indemnification procedures and limitations, including negotiated caps, baskets and an escrow or other agreed security, with customary exclusions and treatment of fundamental and specified claims.

4. Confidentiality; General Provisions. Confidentiality obligations will be mutual and will permit customary disclosures to a party’s affiliates, financing sources and professional advisers, and disclosures required by law, subject to applicable notice and protective steps. The definitive agreement will coordinate this provision with the existing confidentiality agreement, which will remain in effect except as expressly modified. The definitive agreement will also include customary provisions regarding governing law, notices, assignment, entire agreement, amendments, counterparts and dispute resolution.

receiver.requested_changes: The Buyer does not accept USD 45,000,000 as a settled price. Counter at USD 40,000,000, subject to diligence and definitive documentation. Specify that the closing adjustment reduces the price for all indebtedness, unpaid transaction expenses, and working-capital shortfall, with cash and working capital above the agreed target credited to the Seller only to the extent expressly agreed; no double counting. Set the target using a defined methodology and representative historical periods, and attach agreed accounting principles. Require delivery of an estimated closing statement with supporting detail before Closing and a post-Closing true-up with reciprocal access to records, a defined objection period, and an independent accountant whose authority is limited to disputed items. Add customary Buyer protections, including a satisfactory-diligence condition, clear interim operating covenants and consent rights for material out-of-ordinary-course actions, and termination rights if conditions are not met by a stated outside date. The definitive agreement should include detailed, appropriately qualified seller representations, disclosure schedules, bring-down standards, and indemnification with a meaningful escrow, suitable survival periods, and negotiated caps and baskets; fundamental, fraud, and specified claims should receive appropriate separate treatment. Please circulate a revised draft with these points and the proposed target and accounting methodology for review.

Dear Aldous Finch team,

Thank you for the revised draft. The added diligence, closing-adjustment, and indemnification framework is helpful. The Buyer is not yet in a position to accept the USD 45,000,000 price. As a basis to move forward, the Buyer proposes USD 40,000,000, subject to diligence and definitive documentation, with the adjustment and other protections set out in our requested changes.

Please provide the supporting financial and working-capital information through the agreed diligence process and circulate a revised draft that addresses the adjustment methodology, target, true-up mechanics, and remaining definitive terms. We are available to discuss promptly.

Best,
Bellweather Croft LLP
